files.description: Water gauge log (120 rows): gauge (gauge name such as "LA-01"), reading (meters, three decimals; about 3% empty), level (alert level, whole number from 3 to 80, no empty cells), site (dam, canal or lake; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Build a table of the readings indexed by alert level, where the index holds the levels exactly as in the file, and add a column level_above_min that gives each level minus the lowest level in the file. Work with NumPy arrays for the level arithmetic. `result` should be that table with the columns reading and level_above_min, rows in file order.
intended_computation: Return 120 rows in file order: index = level as in the file (values 3-80), reading unchanged, level_above_min = level - min(level) (0-77).

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the index shares the NumPy array, so the later subtraction also shifts the index; 3.x keeps the original levels

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
